hooks.command: node -e "const p=process.env.TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH||''; const skills=[]; if(/schema|presets|brand-kit\.json/.test(p)) skills.push('brand-kit-guard'); if(/exporters/.test(p)) skills.push('exporter-guard'); if(/generators|media\/creative/.test(p)) skills.push('generator-guard'); if(/media/.test(p)) skills.push('media-guard'); if(skills.length) { const fs=require('fs'); const msgs=skills.map(s => { try { return fs.readFileSync('.claude/skills/'+s+'.md','utf8'); } catch { return ''; } }).filter(Boolean); if(msgs.length) console.log(msgs.join('\n---\n')); }"
